tei:div.tei:p: (53)rdo rje phur pa rgyud lugs las smad las dam can bsnyen pa mdor bsdus su btang thabs drag sngags rgya mtsho'i yang gses bzhugs so/ (54)

bcom ldan 'das dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu la phyag 'tshal lo/ sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa dang po dbang thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa'i gang zag gis stod las dkar po zhi ba byang chub sgrub pa'i bskyed rim gsal zhing bsnyen pa'i rtags rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ smad las nag po dgra bgegs bsgral ba la/ dam can bsnyen pa dang ngan sngags bsnyen pa gnyis kyi dang po la/ 'jig rten khams kyi dregs pa can/ bdud pho yab yum rol pa'i sras lha mo re ma ti mched bzhi dang*/ de'i ming po ma hā kā la ste de dag ri rab kyi byang (55) shar mtshams mu le ting gi nang lcags mkhar dug lnga'i rten can la gnas/ gnod sbyin zangs mdog rgyal po yab yum rol pa'i sras bswe mo mched bzhi dang*/ ming po bswai yi skyed bu ni ri rab steng lho phyogs bswe mtsho smug po dug lngā'i rten can la gnas/ srid pa'i phywa he le yab yum rol pa'i sras shwa na ma bzhi ming po shel ging dkar po ni ri rab steng dug mtsho mer bar dung mkhar dkar po dug lnga'i rten can la gnas pa rnams karma he ru ka'i dam tshig la 'dus nas/ lce la bdud rtsi byin/ do rje (56) phur pa lag tu gtad gsang ba'i dbang bskur/ ming po ser btags/ ngan song gi chos las ldog chos nyid ye shes kyi don bstan/ rig pa'i ye shes srog snying du bzhes nas phur bu'i srung mar bskos pa 'jig rten na che ba'i dregs pa can thams cad kyi rjes sor/ rdo rje phur ba'i rnal 'byor pa'i dgos kyi srung mar bsngags pa yin pas/ 'dir ni spyir de'i bsnyen pa tsam btang ba la/ sgrub dkyil las dma' bar lho nub mtshams su/ zan ming la phur pa btab pa'i mthar sman raka gtor ma/ mda' dar dang*/ dar nag rba mkhar tshig gsum la 'grub tu rung na bswe yi byang bu dkaranag la sku dang snying po bkod/ gzhan yang mchod pa'i bye drag dre'u nag lug dkar gyi thod pa/ ri bong dang bong bu rmag gi snying khrag

mi rta grir shi ba'i khra mtsho/ (57) 'o mtsho/ mar khu'i mtsho rnams bshams nas/ lha bsnyen gyis bzlas pa rdzogs rjes/ rgyud las/ gzhan yang thod pa'i gzhal yas su/ sras bcas dam can bcas pa bskyed/ ces pas/ bsnyen phur ni mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi bdag nyid dregs pa can dbang du sdud pa'i gnyen po yin pas/ lcum gzhog ldir ba'i nang du gzhal med khang rdzogs pa la/ gtso bo yab yum dang */ lcum gzhon brgyad la phyogs mtshams kyis khro bo yab yum mgo brnyan dang bcas pa/ rgya mdud gong 'og gi khro bo yab yum/ rgya mdud gyi logs bzhir sgo bzhi/ dpal gyi ngam la phur srung bcu gnyis ming po las mkhan dang bcas pa ting nge 'jin gyis gsal btab la spyan drang ba ni/ (58)bhyo/ stong gsum 'di na dregs pa can/ sus kyangakṣadam la ma chud pa/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i bka' la sdod/ ma mo mkha' 'gro yongs kyi gtso/ dam can ma mo bcu gnyis dang*/ rang rang rigs kyi ming po ni/ khams gsum srog la dbang za zhing*/ glo bur ye 'dregs bdag po ste/ srid pa skos 'debs rgyal po dang*/ e ka ja ṭi bshos pa'i sras/ shwa na spyan gcig mched bzhi dang*/ ming po shel ging dkar po bcas/ ri rgyal lhun po'i steng shed na/dug (59)mtsho mer ba'i nang shed na/ dung mkhar dkar po'i nang nas gshegs bdud nag yab yu rol pa'i sras/ ling ka mgrin bcu chung ma'i tshu/ nag mo re ti mched bzhi dang*/ ming po ma hā kā lar bcas/ ri rab chen po'i byang shar mtshams/ mu le mthing gi mtsho nang gi lcags mkhar nag pa'i nang nas gshegs/ gnod sbyin zangs mdog rgyal po dang*/ yum gcig zangs mgrin ldem pa'i sras/ bswe yi lha (60)mo mched bzhi dang*/ ming po bswe yi skyes bu bcas/ ri rab chen po'i lho nub mtshams/ bswe mtsho mer ba'i dbus shed na/ bswe mkhar smug pa'i nang nas gshegs/ re ti nag la bswe mor dmar/

shwa na dkar ldem ming po ser/ kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis la/ legs nyes stangs 'jin bdag po ste/ lcags kyu'i 'gugs shing phur bus sgrol/ gzhon pa can dang rkyang pa'i tshul/ rnal 'gyur ma nges cir yang ston/ ma mo bdun dang sring mo bzhi/ (61)dregs pa chen po drug la sogs/ sprul pa yang sprul bsam mi khyab/ khyed rnams srog snying nga la yod/ sngon tshe dpal chen khrag 'thung gis/ ji ltar dam la bzhag pa bzhin/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang*/ dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod pa dang*/ nyams pa bdun po bsgral ba'i phyir/ dam can ma g.yel dam la 'dus/ gang la bya ba khyod kyis shes/ rlung las myur ba'i stobs kyis gshegs/ oṃ badzra kro dhā (62)tsitta ma hā mi shu ra shu ra/ khyi ra khyi ra/ bha dha ra ni/ shu la tsi sar shu pār ni/ yo ga shuddha tsitta mā ra li/ kro dha yo ga nī badzra/ dzwa lan dhi ri/ sha ṣa ṇa ja jaḥ dam ma bzhag pa ni/ bhyo/ bam ril thod pa'i gzhal yas nang*/ mthun rjas spyan gzigs tshang zhing mjes/ dam can bzhags shing chags pa'i gnas/ dam tshig nyid las gzhanya ma yin/ thams cad dam tshig chos shes na/ ye shes lha dang mnyam par 'gyur/ sa ma ya mā ma taṃ na rakkan/ (63) zhes bdud rtsi'i bsre/ de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis brlabs te/ dmar gyi gtor ma chen po rang rang 'dod pa'i longs spyod kyi sprin du 'char ba 'di nyid bsngo ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni bcom ldan 'das phur pa'i bka' sdod dam can ma mo bcu gnyis ming po sprul 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ lcags kyu spyang mo dang lcags kyi khyi mo la zhon pa'i shwa na ma gnyis/ gser gyi 'phar ba dang zangs khyi wa mo la zhon pa'i sri la ma gnyis (64)te mu kha chen mo mched bzhi'i zhal du 'bul lo/ dzwa la dzwa la badzra ma ma mukkaṃ la ye ja ya du man dhi shwa ri nī la pu tsa hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ yi daṃ bha ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/

phyi nam zla dus bzhi la dbang byed pa'i bdag nyid chen mo bzhi'i zhal du 'bul lo/ ma tha ma tha badzra/ trag raksha ma ti he dun bhyo/ bswe mo nyis brgya lnga bcu'i dbang mo sa bdag ma bzhi'i zhalal du 'bul lo/ ka taṃ kā (65)ye bi ja ye a ji te a pa ra tsi te pu ki bha ya bha ra tsitta yo gī shwa ri ya tsitta hūm̐ phaṭa/ yi dam bhi nga ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ dpal ldan mgon po nag po'i zhal du 'bul lo/ kā la ma traṃ ma hā kā la ra ti ye ka la rū pa hūm̐ phaṭa/ i dam bha ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bswe yi skyes bu'i zhal du 'bul lo/ mā ra sa ni ra sha ni ra shu bhi kun lan shu lan hūm̐ phaṭa/ i dam bha lingta kha kha khā hi khī/ rgyal po shel (66)ging gi zhal du 'bul lo/ kā ra mā ka ra ya/ tsi tra pa la tri la thun/ i dam bha ling ta kha kha khā hi khī/ ma bdun sring bzhi'i zhal du 'bul lo/ hūm̐ ma ma pa sham ku ru ma tang nya ka ra yi nan/ i daṃ bha ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ dregs pa sde drug gi zhal du 'bul lo/ dha dhi ma ma shi kraṃ karma karmye ya/ sra marta ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ i daṃ bha ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bzhes nas sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu (67)'phang bstod/ rnal 'byor pa'i grogs dan mjod/ phrin las rnam pa bzhi sgrubs/ 'jig rten gyi rgud pa sol/ dmag 'khrugs pa nad dal bzlog khyad par du yang bal yul yang le shod du rig 'jin chen po padma 'byung gnas kyi bka' dang dam la bzhag rdo rje phur pa'i srung mar dbang bskur/ srog snying mdongs gsol du phul nas ji ltar khas blangs pa'i dam tshig gnyen po dran par mjod/ rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa dang de 'jin gyi (68)skyes bu dam pa rnams la log par blta zhing nyams pa bdun dang bcas pa'i dgra bgegs rnams ltas dang cho 'phrul sna tshogs pas spa skong la/ drag shul gyi las la mngon du spyod pas thal ba'i rdul bzhin du brlag par mjod cig

ces dam bsgrags shing phrin las bcol ba ni/ bhyo/ rgyal bal gnyis kyi mtshams shed na/ dgun yang me tog padma skyes/ chu yang ba yang chub bdud rtsi'i chu/ yang le shod kyi brag phug tu/ phur pa grub pa'i rag 'jin gyis/ bka' dang (69)dam la bzhag pa ni/ dam can ma mo bcu gnyis te/ dang po gcig la yang mtshan stong ma/ 'jig rten 'das kyang 'khor ba na/ shwa na mu kha mched bzhir ston/ lcags kyi spyang mo mgo dgu ma/ lcags kyi khyi mo mtshams mig can/ zangs kyi wa mo rkang gsum dang*/ gser gyi 'phar ba lce brgyad ste/ mi mo'i lus la phra men gdong*/ sprul pa yang sprul bsam mi khyab/ 'das dang ma 'das mtshams shed nas/ bdag nyid chen (70)mo mched bzhir ste/ re ma ti dang re ma du/ re ma ja dang re ma ju/ khyung drel sha ba chu lnga zhon/ bar snang kun la dbang bsgyur nas/ nam zla dus bzhi'i bdag mo mjod/ rang rgyud can du ston pa ni/ sa bdag bswe yi lha mo ste/ tsha ba rong na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ de byin gza' yi bu mo ser/ zhags gi mtsho la mnga' dbang mjad/ chibs ni gza' rta zhur po chibs/ shu lan dhā ri srog gi snying*/ mang yul so na bzhugs pa ni/ rakta'i (71)mtsho la mnga' dbang mjad/ bswe byin btsan gyi bu mo dmar/ chis su btsan rta dmar po chibs/ tsa mun da ri srog gi snying*/ snye nam yul na bzhugs pa ni/ phag byin klu yi bu mo ljang*/ chibs su klu rta ljang ku chibs/ ki king da ri srog gi snying*/ bal yul mthil na bzhugs pa ni/ ya byin bdud kyi bu mo mthing*/ mar khu'i mtsho la mnga' dbang mjad/ chibs su bdud rta mthing nag chibs/ ku ma da ra srog gi snying*/ (72)kun kyang rang mdog ber chen gsol/ ral pa phur pa'i lan tshar can/ ming po'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ phrin las bcol ba ni/ rgyud las/ bran dang pho nya bka' nyan tshogs/ khyod kyis thugs dam dus la babs/ nga yi spyan sngar khas blangs bzhin/ phyi rabs rnal 'byor phrin las kyi/

bstan par dgra 'dre byung ba'i tshe/ shwa na mu kha'i dus la babs/ bdag nyid chen mo'i dus la babs/ sa bdag chen mo'i dus la babs/ dregs pa mang po'i dus la (73)babs/ khyed kyis mthu rtsal rab tu phyungs/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa dang*/ dkon mchog sku dgra dben rtsa 'joms/ chos khrims 'dral dang slob dpon dgra rnal 'byor 'joms pa la sogs pa/ bsad dang dbab dang nad ngan gyis/ ci nas brlag par khyed kyi gyis/ ces bskul lo/ de nas ye shes kyi lha dang srungam thams cad srog snying 'dus pa dha dhi 'bring po spu gri dang dbye ba rig 'jin 'jigs med gling pas legs par byed pa 'di nyid la tshig dril du brtson pa ste/ rgyud las/ dril te rab tu bzlas pa yi/ mdangs (74) dang bralal bar rab tu nges/ zhes pas gzhi snying gcig tu dril te bzlas pa'i skabs dmigs pa rtse gcig pas gsung pa ni/ bdag nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis dam can rnams kyi srog snying phrog cing ci bcol ba'i las nyan par bsam la/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya badze la ni/ jaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pu ru pu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ dzwa la dzwa la/ ma thā ma thā/ dha ti ma ma karma i daṃ ma taṃ nya ka ra ja ye bi ja ye a ji te a pa ra tsi te ka taṃ ka te ma ra se na sra marta na ye sarba big nan (75) baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzlas pas/ rmi lam du srog chags bsad pa dang*/ bya skad 'tshor ba sogs spyi'i rtags dang*/ dgos rtags gcan gzan gyi tshogs rmi na shwa na mi ste/ mo btsun dang nag mo bya nag dre'u rta bong bya sogs byung na bdag nyid ma ste/ a tsa ra dang mno mo dang bud med nag mo dang*/ nya sbrul byung na bswe mo ste/ mi rengs dkar dmar dang rta pa'i tshogs rmi na skyes bu ging ste bas rtags rnams ma byung bar bzla'o/ bsnyen pa grangs tshad ma gsung bas/ de ltar dam can 'go ba'i rtags tshang nas bskul ba ni/ gtor ma bzang po bshams la/

rgyud las/ dpal gyi pho nya las mkhan mo/ sogs smad las kyi skabs dam can bcu (76) gnyis ming po dang bcas pa'i bskul btang bar gsung kyang*/ 'dir phur pa spyi'i dgos chas raka ta tshar gsum gyis bskul ba ni/ phud dang kar ta bsres la/ dang po pho nya la bka' bsgo ba'i phyir phur nas/ hūm̐/dngos grub bar gcod byed pa'i bgegs/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ zung shig rgyob cig rnam par chings/ gtogs shig grogs dang bral bar gyis/ drang nges par khug la smrar chug cig phob cig rnam par gzir bar gyis/ nga yi dbang du gyur nas ni/ bsgo ba'i bka' la nyan par byos/ ma hā (77)raka ta khā hi/ gnyis pa dam can gnad la dbab phyir/ hūm̐/ bran dang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs/ khyed kyis dam tshig dus la bab/ sngon chad ji bzhin bcas pa yi/ mngon spyod phrin las myur du mjod/ ma hā raka ta khā hi/ gsum pa mthu dang rdzu 'phrul 'phrog pa'i chod du/ hūm̐/ dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ lha 'am 'on te bdud kyang rung*/ nga la bar chad byed pa rnams/ mthu dang rdzu (78)'phrul med par mjod/ ma hā raka ta khā hi/ ces bskul mthar tshogs tha ma 'brel bar ling ga bsgral zhing bstab pa'i bar bya/ lhag ma btang la dngos grub lha las blangs ba gzhung bzhin bya'o/ cig char rigs can bi mas byin brlabs shing*/ spa gro'i phug rlang chen dpal seng ges/ dbang bskur rdzogs shing bla mas gtad brgya bkrol/ padma dbang chen nas brgyud da lta'i bar/ dngos grub brnyes pa'i rig 'jin zam ma chad/ brgyud pa'i byin brlabs sprin phung ma zhig ba/ snga 'gyur bka' bab chu bo bzhi rdzogs pa'i/ drag sngags rdo rje 'bar ba'i lcags ri yin/ gang gi rigs sngags dus mtha'i zhugs kyi lces/ bdun ldan nyams (79)(80) pa'i tshing tshing rming yod du/ bsreg la stobs ldan sbyor ba'i wa ya we/ 'bod pa'i rdo rje'i pho nya 'dis mtshon shog

ces pa 'di yang mchog sprul badzra yakṣa ra'i bzhes skong du sngags btsun padma las 'brel rtsal gyis rgyud dang man ngag gi gnad legs par bsdebs te bris pa 'di la dam can nye bar 'go ba'i mtshan ltas yang dag par mthong zhing byin rlabs kyi bab dang ldan par rigs par bya'o/// /
